saw_lines: Meal delivery buyers want to know how the food arrives and stays safe before they risk a first order.
So the sale is lost in the ad, when a buyer hesitates on shipping and moves on before ordering.
Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping. Open new buyer ads with the shipping answer and free shipping at 10+ meals.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site answers how it ships, but 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no reason to order. Open new buyer ads with the shipping answer and free shipping at 10+ meals, in three variations.

Your site explains how meals are packed, yet 0 of 30 ads show how the box arrives. Film a video of the box on a doorstep, with the meal ready in 3 minutes, so buyers picture delivery before they click.

None of your 30 ads shows a number that proves the meals work, so a buyer weighing a weekly plan has nothing to trust. Collect one figure, such as a review count or meals shipped, and open three ads with it.
8 of 21 copy ads open on one line, no time for meal prep, so the account leans heavily on one hook. Test two new openers, the 3 minute ready time and the 40 to 60g of protein, against it.

ads_1: Shipping and box arrival up front, tested against the meal prep opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
